subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What retention and replay contract should OpenClaw use for Gemini visible `textSignature` values in same-route Google history?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally replay valid same-route signatures, but the issue shows unbounded visible-text signatures can bloat sessions and suppress replies; changing this safely requires provider contract ownership.

options.title: Bound Visible-Text Signatures
options.body: Preserve required tool/native-thinking signatures while dropping, capping, or externalizing optional visible `textSignature` values before replay.

options.title: Keep Full Signature Replay
options.body: Retain all current same-route signature replay behavior and accept the session-bloat risk as part of the Google provider contract.

options.title: Split A Design Tracker
options.body: Open a narrower provider-contract discussion and keep this issue blocked until that policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Bound Visible-Text Signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required tool/native-thinking signatures while dropping, capping, or externalizing optional visible `textSignature` values before replay.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger appears in recent Google transport/reasoning history and merged or verified adjacent signature/reasoning fixes, making him the best available routing owner for the provider replay contract.
